welcome:
Welcome to the Alertmanager CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Alertmanager instance.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check what alerts are currently firing in the cluster.
There's a DiskFull alert on node-3. You have planned maintenance tonight — silence it for 4 hours.
steps.expect: amtool silence add alertname=DiskFull instance=node-3:9100 --duration=4h --author=oncall --comment="Planned disk maintenance on node-3"
steps.hint: Try: amtool silence add alertname=DiskFull instance=node-3:9100 --duration=4h --author=oncall --comment="Planned disk maintenance on node-3"

steps.instruction: Verify the silence was created by listing active silences.
Good — silence c1d2e3f4 is active. Now check the Alertmanager status to confirm the instance is healthy.
Maintenance finished early. Expire the silence so alerts flow again.
Confirm the silence is gone and alerts are active again.
Finally, verify the DiskFull alert is firing again now that the silence is expired.
A team reports they are not receiving PodCrashLooping alerts. Start by checking the Alertmanager config is valid.
Config is valid. Now display the full routing tree to understand how alerts are routed.
Test where a PodCrashLooping alert with severity=critical would be routed.
steps.expect: amtool config routes test alertname=PodCrashLooping severity=critical namespace=production
steps.hint: Try: amtool config routes test alertname=PodCrashLooping severity=critical namespace=production

steps.instruction: It routes to the 'platform-critical' receiver. Check which receivers are configured.
Now query the API for currently active alerts to see if PodCrashLooping is actually firing.
The alert is suppressed! Check if there is a silence matching this alert.
Found silence a9b8c7d6 matching PodCrashLooping. Expire it so the team gets notified.
Verify the cluster is healthy and peers are connected so notifications won't be duplicated.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  amtool alert query              — List firing alerts (with optional label matchers)
  amtool silence add              — Create a new silence
  amtool silence query            — List active silences
  amtool silence expire           — Expire a silence by ID
  amtool silence update           — Update an existing silence
  amtool check-config             — Validate Alertmanager configuration
  amtool config routes show       — Display the routing tree
  amtool config routes test       — Test which route matches given labels
  amtool cluster show             — Show cluster/peer status
  curl .../api/v2/alerts          — Query alerts via HTTP API
  curl .../api/v2/silences        — Query silences via HTTP API
  curl .../api/v2/status          — Alertmanager instance status
  curl .../api/v2/receivers       — List configured receivers

  scenario                        — Start a guided lab
  clear                           — Clear the terminal
  help                            — Show this help
